import os

# Load environment variables
load_dotenv()
def create_app():
app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = os.getenv('SECRET_KEY', 'dev_key_for_development')
# Register blueprints
from app.routes import main_bp
app.register_blueprint(main_bp)
return app

import psycopg2
from psycopg2.extras import RealDictCursor
from datetime import datetime
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import os
def get_db_connection():
db_url = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL")
if not db_url:
raise ValueError("DATABASE_URL environment variable not set")
parsed_url = urlparse(db_url)
print(parsed_url)
return psycopg2.connect(
host=parsed_url.hostname,
database=parsed_url.path[1:], # skip the leading '/'
user=parsed_url.username,
password=parsed_url.password,
port=parsed_url.port
)
def get_all_staff():
conn = get_db_connection()
cur = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)
cur.execute('SELECT * FROM staff ORDER BY id')
staff = cur.fetchall()
cur.close()
conn.close()
return staff
def get_menu_items_by_category(category):
conn = get_db_connection()
cur = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)
cur.execute('SELECT * FROM menu_items WHERE category = %s ORDER BY name', (category,))
items = cur.fetchall()
cur.close()
conn.close()
return items
def seed_data():
"""Seed the database with initial data if tables are empty"""
conn = get_db_connection()
cur = conn.cursor()
# Create tables if they don't exist
cur.execute("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff (
id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
name TEXT NOT NULL,
role TEXT NOT NULL,
bio TEXT NOT NULL,
image_url TEXT NOT NULL,
created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
""")
cur.execute("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS menu_items (
id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
name TEXT NOT NULL,
description TEXT NOT NULL,
price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
category TEXT NOT NULL,
image_url TEXT,
created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
""")
# Check if tables are empty
cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff")
staff_count = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_items")
menu_count = cur.fetchone()[0]
if staff_count == 0 and menu_count == 0:
print("Seeding database with initial data...")
# Add staff members
staff_data = [
(

@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
from flask import Blueprint, render_template
from app.models import get_all_staff, get_menu_items_by_category
# Create a Blueprint for our routes
main_bp = Blueprint('main', __name__)
@main_bp.route('/')
def home():
"""Route for the home page"""
return render_template('home.html', title='Welcome to Fries')
@main_bp.route('/about')
def about():
"""Route for the about page"""
# Get all staff members from the database
staff_members = get_all_staff()
return render_template('about.html', title='About Us', staff=staff_members)
@main_bp.route('/menu')
def menu():
"""Route for the menu page"""
# Get menu items grouped by category
meals = get_menu_items_by_category('meals')
beverages = get_menu_items_by_category('beverages')
snacks = get_menu_items_by_category('snacks')
return render_template(
'menu.html',
title='Our Menu',
meals=meals,
beverages=beverages,
snacks=snacks
)

/**
* Fries Restaurant - Main JavaScript
* -----------------------------------
*/
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
// Handle navbar background on scroll for home page
if (document.querySelector('.hero-section')) {
const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
if (window.scrollY > 50) {
navbar.classList.add('navbar-scrolled');
} else {
navbar.classList.remove('navbar-scrolled');
}
});
// Trigger the scroll event on page load
window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'));
}
// Add smooth scrolling to all links
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
if (target) {
e.preventDefault();
window.scrollTo({
top: target.offsetTop - 70, // Adjust for navbar height
behavior: 'smooth'
});
}
});
});
// Menu items hover effect
const menuCards = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-card, .menu-item-card');
menuCards.forEach(card => {
card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
this.querySelector('img').style.transform = 'scale(1.05)';
});
card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
this.querySelector('img').style.transform = 'scale(1)';
});
});
// Testimonial carousel autoplay
const testimonialCarousel = document.getElementById('testimonialCarousel');
if (testimonialCarousel) {
const carousel = new bootstrap.Carousel(testimonialCarousel, {
interval: 5000,
pause: 'hover'
});
}
// Animation on scroll (if AOS is not used)
const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.animate');
if (animatedElements.length > 0) {
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
entries.forEach(entry => {
if (entry.isIntersecting) {
entry.target.classList.add('animated');
}
});
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
animatedElements.forEach(element => {
observer.observe(element);
});
}
});

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block content %}
<!-- About Hero Section -->
<section class="page-hero about-hero">
<div class="hero-overlay"></div>
<div class="container h-100">
<div class="row h-100 align-items-center text-center">
<div class="col-lg-10 mx-auto">
<h1 class="display-4 text-white mb-3" data-aos="fade-up">Our Story</h1>
<p class="lead text-white mb-0" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="200">The passion and people behind Fries Restaurant</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Our Story Section -->
<section class="py-5">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row align-items-center">
<div class="col-lg-6 mb-5 mb-lg-0" data-aos="fade-right">
<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/3184183/pexels-photo-3184183.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1" alt="Restaurant Story" class="img-fluid rounded shadow-lg">
</div>
<div class="col-lg-6 ps-lg-5" data-aos="fade-left">
<h6 class="text-primary">OUR HISTORY</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-4">From Dream to Culinary Destination</h2>
<p class="lead">Fries began in 2010 as a small family restaurant with a big vision.</p>
<p>What started as Emma Thompson's dream to create a restaurant that honored traditional recipes while embracing modern culinary techniques has evolved into one of the city's most beloved dining establishments.</p>
<p>Over the years, we've grown not just in size but in our commitment to culinary excellence. We source the finest ingredients, collaborate with local farmers, and continuously innovate while respecting culinary traditions.</p>
<p>Our philosophy is simple: exceptional food should be complemented by warm hospitality in a welcoming atmosphere. This belief guides everything we do, from how we prepare our dishes to how we interact with our guests.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Philosophy Section -->
<section class="py-5 bg-light">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row text-center mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto">
<h6 class="text-primary">OUR PHILOSOPHY</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-4">What We Believe</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<!-- Value 1 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up">
<div class="card h-100 border-0 value-card">
<div class="card-body text-center p-4">
<div class="value-icon mb-4">
<i class="fas fa-leaf fa-3x text-primary"></i>
</div>
<h4 class="mb-3">Quality Ingredients</h4>
<p>We believe exceptional cuisine begins with the finest ingredients. We partner with local farmers and suppliers who share our commitment to quality and sustainability.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Value 2 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="100">
<div class="card h-100 border-0 value-card">
<div class="card-body text-center p-4">
<div class="value-icon mb-4">
<i class="fas fa-utensils fa-3x text-primary"></i>
</div>
<h4 class="mb-3">Culinary Craftsmanship</h4>
<p>Our chefs blend traditional techniques with innovative approaches, creating dishes that honor culinary heritage while embracing creative expression.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Value 3 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="200">
<div class="card h-100 border-0 value-card">
<div class="card-body text-center p-4">
<div class="value-icon mb-4">
<i class="fas fa-heart fa-3x text-primary"></i>
</div>
<h4 class="mb-3">Heartfelt Hospitality</h4>
<p>We believe dining is about more than food—it's about creating memorable experiences through genuine care, attention to detail, and warm service.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Meet Our Team -->
<section class="py-5 team-section">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row text-center mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto">
<h6 class="text-primary">THE PEOPLE</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-4">Meet Our Team</h2>
<p class="lead">The passionate individuals who bring Fries to life</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
{% for member in staff %}
<div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="{{ loop.index0 * 100 }}">
<div class="card team-card h-100">
<div class="team-image-container">
<img src="{{ member.image_url }}" class="card-img-top" alt="{{ member.name }}">
</div>
<div class="card-body text-center">
<h4 class="card-title mb-1">{{ member.name }}</h4>
<p class="text-primary mb-3">{{ member.role }}</p>
<p class="card-text">{{ member.bio }}</p>
<div class="social-icons mt-3">
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-instagram"></i></a>
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-twitter"></i></a>
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-linkedin-in"></i></a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
{% endfor %}
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Join Our Team CTA -->
<section class="py-5 bg-light">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row align-items-center">
<div class="col-lg-8 mb-4 mb-lg-0">
<h6 class="text-primary">CAREERS</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Join Our Team</h2>
<p class="lead mb-0">We're always looking for passionate people to join our culinary family. If you love food, hospitality, and creating exceptional experiences, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-4 text-lg-end">
<a href="#" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">View Opportunities</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
{% endblock %}
{% block extra_js %}
<script src="https://unpkg.com/aos@next/dist/aos.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
// Initialize AOS
AOS.init({
duration: 800,
easing: 'ease-in-out',
once: true
});
// Handle navbar background
const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
navbar.classList.add('navbar-scrolled');
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
{% block extra_css %}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/aos@next/dist/aos.css" />
{% endblock %}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>{% block title %}{{ title }} - Fries Restaurant{% endblock %}</title>
<!-- Bootstrap 5 CSS -->
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<!-- Font Awesome -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
<!-- Google Fonts -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;700&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<!-- Custom CSS -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ url_for('static', filename='css/style.css') }}">
{% block extra_css %}{% endblock %}
</head>
<body>
<!-- Navigation -->
<nav class="navbar navbar-expand-lg navbar-dark fixed-top">
<div class="container">
<a class="navbar-brand" href="{{ url_for('main.home') }}">
<span class="restaurant-logo">Fries</span>
</a>
<button class="navbar-toggler" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#navbarNav" aria-controls="navbarNav" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle navigation">
<span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
</button>
<div class="collapse navbar-collapse" id="navbarNav">
<ul class="navbar-nav ms-auto">
<li class="nav-item">
<a class="nav-link {% if request.path == url_for('main.home') %}active{% endif %}" href="{{ url_for('main.home') }}">Home</a>
</li>
<li class="nav-item">
<a class="nav-link {% if request.path == url_for('main.about') %}active{% endif %}" href="{{ url_for('main.about') }}">About</a>
</li>
<li class="nav-item">
<a class="nav-link {% if request.path == url_for('main.menu') %}active{% endif %}" href="{{ url_for('main.menu') }}">Menu</a>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="ms-3 d-none d-lg-block">
<a href="#" class="btn btn-outline-light reservation-btn">Reserve a Table</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</nav>
<!-- Main Content -->
<main>
{% block content %}{% endblock %}
</main>
<!-- Footer -->
<footer class="bg-dark text-light py-5">
<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4 mb-md-0">
<h4 class="mb-4">Fries</h4>
<p>Experience the perfect blend of tradition and innovation in every bite at Fries.</p>
<div class="social-icons mt-3">
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-facebook-f"></i></a>
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-instagram"></i></a>
<a href="#" class="me-2"><i class="fab fa-twitter"></i></a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4 mb-md-0">
<h5 class="mb-4">Hours</h5>
<ul class="list-unstyled footer-hours">
<li>Monday - Friday: 11am - 10pm</li>
<li>Saturday: 10am - 11pm</li>
<li>Sunday: 10am - 9pm</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="col-md-4">
<h5 class="mb-4">Contact Us</h5>
<ul class="list-unstyled footer-contact">
<li><i class="fas fa-map-marker-alt me-2"></i> Main Road, Colombo 7</li>
<li><i class="fas fa-phone me-2"></i> (94) 424-7671</li>
<li><i class="fas fa-envelope me-2"></i> info@fries.htb</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row mt-4 pt-4 border-top">
<div class="col-md-6 text-center text-md-start">
<p class="mb-0">&copy; 2025 Fries Restaurant. All rights reserved.</p>
</div>
<div class="col-md-6 text-center text-md-end">
<a href="#" class="text-light me-3">Privacy Policy</a>
<a href="#" class="text-light">Terms of Service</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</footer>
<!-- Bootstrap JS -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<!-- Custom JS -->
<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/main.js') }}"></script>
{% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}
</body>
</html>

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block content %}
<!-- Hero Section -->
<section class="hero-section">
<div class="hero-overlay"></div>
<div class="container h-100">
<div class="row h-100 align-items-center">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto text-center text-white">
<h1 class="display-3 fw-bold mb-4 hero-title" data-aos="fade-up">Welcome to Fries</h1>
<p class="lead mb-5 hero-subtitle" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="200">Experience culinary excellence with every bite</p>
<div data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="400">
<a href="{{ url_for('main.menu') }}" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg me-3">View Menu</a>
<a href="#" class="btn btn-outline-light btn-lg">Reserve a Table</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- About Teaser Section -->
<section class="py-5 about-teaser">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row align-items-center">
<div class="col-lg-6 mb-4 mb-lg-0" data-aos="fade-right">
<div class="about-image-container">
<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/2696064/pexels-photo-2696064.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1" alt="Restaurant interior" class="img-fluid rounded">
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-6 ps-lg-5" data-aos="fade-left">
<h6 class="text-primary">OUR STORY</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-4">A Culinary Journey Since 2010</h2>
<p class="lead">Fries began with a simple vision: to create extraordinary dining experiences through passion, creativity, and the finest ingredients.</p>
<p>Founded by Emma Thompson, our restaurant has grown from a small neighborhood gem to a celebrated culinary destination. We remain committed to our founding principles of exceptional food, warm hospitality, and unforgettable moments.</p>
<a href="{{ url_for('main.about') }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary mt-3">Learn More About Us</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Featured Menu Items -->
<section class="py-5 bg-light featured-menu">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row text-center mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto">
<h6 class="text-primary">OUR SPECIALTIES</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Featured Dishes</h2>
<p class="lead">Discover our chef's selections, crafted with passion and the finest ingredients</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<!-- Featured Item 1 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up">
<div class="card menu-card h-100">
<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/1437267/pexels-photo-1437267.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1" class="card-img-top" alt="Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="menu-price">$18.95</div>
<h5 class="card-title">Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta</h5>
<p class="card-text">Al dente pasta tossed with succulent shrimp in a rich garlic butter sauce, topped with fresh parsley and Parmesan.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Featured Item 2 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="100">
<div class="card menu-card h-100">
<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/723198/pexels-photo-723198.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1" class="card-img-top" alt="Spicy Thai Basil Fried Rice">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="menu-price">$16.50</div>
<h5 class="card-title">Spicy Thai Basil Fried Rice</h5>
<p class="card-text">Aromatic jasmine rice stir-fried with Thai basil, chili, garlic, and your choice of protein.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Featured Item 3 -->
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="200">
<div class="card menu-card h-100">
<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/1893555/pexels-photo-1893555.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1" class="card-img-top" alt="Truffle Parmesan Fries">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="menu-price">$8.95</div>
<h5 class="card-title">Truffle Parmesan Fries</h5>
<p class="card-text">Crispy golden fries tossed with truffle oil, grated Parmesan cheese, and fresh herbs, served with a side of garlic aioli.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="text-center mt-4">
<a href="{{ url_for('main.menu') }}" class="btn btn-primary">View Full Menu</a>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Testimonials -->
<section class="py-5 testimonials">
<div class="container py-5">
<div class="row text-center mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto">
<h6 class="text-primary">TESTIMONIALS</h6>
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">What Our Guests Say</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto">
<div id="testimonialCarousel" class="carousel slide" data-bs-ride="carousel">
<div class="carousel-inner">
<!-- Testimonial 1 -->
<div class="carousel-item active">
<div class="testimonial-item text-center">
<div class="testimonial-content">
<i class="fas fa-quote-left fa-3x text-primary mb-4"></i>
<p class="lead mb-4">"The flavors at Fries are absolutely exquisite. Every dish tells a story, and the attention to detail is remarkable. This has become our favorite spot for special occasions."</p>
<h5 class="testimonial-author">Michael & Jennifer</h5>
<p class="text-muted">Regular Guests</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Testimonial 2 -->
<div class="carousel-item">
<div class="testimonial-item text-center">
<div class="testimonial-content">
<i class="fas fa-quote-left fa-3x text-primary mb-4"></i>
<p class="lead mb-4">"I've traveled the world and dined at many restaurants, but Fries offers something truly unique. The fusion of flavors and the impeccable service make it a standout dining experience."</p>
<h5 class="testimonial-author">Robert Chen</h5>
<p class="text-muted">Food Critic</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Testimonial 3 -->
<div class="carousel-item">
<div class="testimonial-item text-center">
<div class="testimonial-content">
<i class="fas fa-quote-left fa-3x text-primary mb-4"></i>
<p class="lead mb-4">"The atmosphere at Fries is as exceptional as the food. Warm, inviting, and sophisticated without being pretentious. It's our go-to place to impress out-of-town guests."</p>
<h5 class="testimonial-author">Sarah & David</h5>
<p class="text-muted">Monthly Visitors</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="carousel-indicators testimonial-indicators">
<button type="button" data-bs-target="#testimonialCarousel" data-bs-slide-to="0" class="active" aria-current="true" aria-label="Testimonial 1"></button>
<button type="button" data-bs-target="#testimonialCarousel" data-bs-slide-to="1" aria-label="Testimonial 2"></button>
<button type="button" data-bs-target="#testimonialCarousel" data-bs-slide-to="2" aria-label="Testimonial 3"></button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Call to Action -->
<section class="py-5 bg-primary text-white cta-section">
<div class="container py-4">
<div class="row align-items-center">
<div class="col-lg-9 mb-4 mb-lg-0">
<h2 class="mb-2">Ready to experience Fries?</h2>
<p class="lead mb-0">Reserve your table today and embark on a culinary journey with us.</p>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-3 text-lg-end">
<a href="#" class="btn btn-light btn-lg">Reserve Now</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
{% endblock %}
{% block extra_js %}
<script src="https://unpkg.com/aos@next/dist/aos.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
// Initialize AOS
AOS.init({
duration: 800,
easing: 'ease-in-out',
once: true
});
// Handle navbar background on scroll
const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
if (window.scrollY > 50) {
navbar.classList.add('navbar-scrolled');
} else {
navbar.classList.remove('navbar-scrolled');
}
});
// Trigger the scroll event on page load
window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'));
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
{% block extra_css %}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/aos@next/dist/aos.css" />
{% endblock %}

{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block content %}
<!-- Menu Hero Section -->
<section class="page-hero menu-hero">
<div class="hero-overlay"></div>
<div class="container h-100">
<div class="row h-100 align-items-center text-center">
<div class="col-lg-10 mx-auto">
<h1 class="display-4 text-white mb-3" data-aos="fade-up">Our Menu</h1>
<p class="lead text-white mb-0" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="200">Culinary creations crafted with passion and precision</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Menu Navigation -->
<section class="py-4 bg-light menu-nav">
<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-12">
<ul class="nav nav-pills menu-tabs justify-content-center" id="menuTabs" role="tablist">
<li class="nav-item" role="presentation">
<button class="nav-link active" id="meals-tab" data-bs-toggle="pill" data-bs-target="#meals" type="button" role="tab" aria-controls="meals" aria-selected="true">Main Courses</button>
</li>
<li class="nav-item" role="presentation">
<button class="nav-link" id="snacks-tab" data-bs-toggle="pill" data-bs-target="#snacks" type="button" role="tab" aria-controls="snacks" aria-selected="false">Appetizers & Sides</button>
</li>
<li class="nav-item" role="presentation">
<button class="nav-link" id="beverages-tab" data-bs-toggle="pill" data-bs-target="#beverages" type="button" role="tab" aria-controls="beverages" aria-selected="false">Beverages</button>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Menu Content -->
<section class="py-5 menu-content">
<div class="container py-4">
<div class="tab-content" id="menuTabsContent">
<!-- Meals Tab -->
<div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="meals" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="meals-tab">
<div class="row mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto text-center">
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Main Courses</h2>
<p class="lead">Exquisite entrées crafted with the finest ingredients</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
{% for item in meals %}
<div class="col-lg-6 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="{{ loop.index0 * 100 }}">
<div class="card menu-item-card h-100">
<div class="row g-0 h-100">
<div class="col-md-4">
<img src="{{ item.image_url }}" class="img-fluid rounded-start menu-item-image" alt="{{ item.name }}">
</div>
<div class="col-md-8">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
<h5 class="card-title mb-0">{{ item.name }}</h5>
<span class="menu-item-price">${{ "%.2f"|format(item.price) }}</span>
</div>
<p class="card-text">{{ item.description }}</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
{% endfor %}
</div>
</div>
<!-- Snacks Tab -->
<div class="tab-pane fade" id="snacks" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="snacks-tab">
<div class="row mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto text-center">
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Appetizers & Sides</h2>
<p class="lead">Perfect starters and accompaniments to complement your meal</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
{% for item in snacks %}
<div class="col-lg-6 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="{{ loop.index0 * 100 }}">
<div class="card menu-item-card h-100">
<div class="row g-0 h-100">
<div class="col-md-4">
<img src="{{ item.image_url }}" class="img-fluid rounded-start menu-item-image" alt="{{ item.name }}">
</div>
<div class="col-md-8">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
<h5 class="card-title mb-0">{{ item.name }}</h5>
<span class="menu-item-price">${{ "%.2f"|format(item.price) }}</span>
</div>
<p class="card-text">{{ item.description }}</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
{% endfor %}
</div>
</div>
<!-- Beverages Tab -->
<div class="tab-pane fade" id="beverages" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="beverages-tab">
<div class="row mb-5">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto text-center">
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Beverages</h2>
<p class="lead">Refreshing drinks to complement your dining experience</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
{% for item in beverages %}
<div class="col-lg-6 mb-4" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="{{ loop.index0 * 100 }}">
<div class="card menu-item-card h-100">
<div class="row g-0 h-100">
<div class="col-md-4">
<img src="{{ item.image_url }}" class="img-fluid rounded-start menu-item-image" alt="{{ item.name }}">
</div>
<div class="col-md-8">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
<h5 class="card-title mb-0">{{ item.name }}</h5>
<span class="menu-item-price">${{ "%.2f"|format(item.price) }}</span>
</div>
<p class="card-text">{{ item.description }}</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
{% endfor %}
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Special Dietary Needs -->
<section class="py-5 bg-light">
<div class="container py-4">
<div class="row mb-4">
<div class="col-lg-8 mx-auto text-center">
<h2 class="display-5 mb-3">Dietary Accommodations</h2>
<p class="lead">We're committed to ensuring everyone can enjoy our culinary creations</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4 mb-md-0" data-aos="fade-up">
<div class="card h-100 border-0 dietary-card">
<div class="card-body text-center p-4">
<div class="dietary-icon mb-3">
<i class="fas fa-leaf fa-2x text-success"></i>
</div>
<h4 class="mb-3">Vegetarian Options</h4>
<p>We offer a variety of flavorful vegetarian dishes across our menu, crafted with the same attention to detail as all our creations.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-md-4 mb-4 mb-md-0" data-aos="fade-up" data-aos-delay="100">
<div class="card h-100 border-0 dietary-card">
<div class="card-body text-center p-4">
<div class="dietary-icon mb-3">
<i class="fas fa-seedling fa-2x text-success"></i>
</div>
<h4 class="mb-3">Gluten-Free Choices</h4>
<p>Many of our dishes can be prepared gluten-free without compromising on flavor. Please inform your server about your dietary needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
